en: Black‑and‑white image of a large ocean liner with two funnels sailing close to shore, with a dramatic, flat‑topped mountain massif in the background. The ship's name "DOMINION MONARCH" is visible on the bow, and printed caption text at the bottom reads "Q.S.M.V. 'DOMINION MONARCH' 26,500 tons." The scene appears to be a vintage promotional or souvenir postcard of the ship in front of a coastal landscape.
